content: Anti-patterns observed: venue booking engines and availability calendars (Orphmedia) belong to venues not production houses; Beyond DXB ships client portal, instant quote, live equipment inventory, and an app — overbuilt for a brand marketing site; Spectrum’s blog + upcoming-exhibition calendar requires live content ops; Stand Creators SEO-farms dozens of service/location pages; Rocket.new Curate template uses scroll-jacked cinematic hero and hover soundscapes that conflict with a classy premium brief. PROJECT.md already excludes CMS, e-commerce/booking, loud 3D/WebGL, client portal, blog, careers, live case-study inventory. Google Translate widgets and flag language switchers are bilingual anti-patterns per AivenSoft.
